chunks: Hamzah ibn Muhammad al-Alawi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim informed us, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, who said:

I described to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) the statement of Hisham al-Jawaliqi and what he says about the fortunate young man, and I described to him the statement of Hisham ibn al-Hakam. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Verily, Allah, the Mighty and High, is not resembled by anything.'

key_terms.إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Verily, Allah, the Mighty and High, a common opening for authoritative theological statements.
key_terms.الشَّابِّ الْمُوفَّقِ: The fortunate young man, referring to a specific individual discussed in theological debates.
key_terms.لَا يُشَبِّهُهُ شَيْءٌ: Nothing resembles Him, the core doctrine of divine non-resemblance (tanzih).
key_terms.هِشَامٌ الْجَوَالِقِيُّ: Hisham al-Jawaliqi, a prominent Shia theologian known for his views on divine attributes.

ai.seo_question: What is the theological stance on whether anything resembles Allah according to Hisham al-Jawaliqi and Hisham ibn al-Hakam?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid* highlights the Imam’s evaluation of the Mu'tazili-influenced theologians Hisham al-Jawaliqi and Hisham ibn al-Hakam, using their views to anchor the doctrine of divine simplicity. By affirming that 'nothing resembles Allah,' the Imam reinforces the Shia principle of *tanzih* (divine transcendence), rejecting anthropomorphism (*tashbih*) and asserting that God’s essence is entirely distinct from created forms and bodies.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 1. Hamzah ibn Muhammad al-`Alawi (RA) said: `Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, on the authority of Muhammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of Yunus ibn `Abd al-Rahman, on Muhammad ibn Hukaym reported that

I described the statement of Hisham al-Jawaliqi, and what he says about a fortunate young man, and described to him the word of Hisham ibn al-Hakam. He (AS):” Verily, nothing resembles Allah, the Mighty and High.
